scope: Tenant-scoped Data Stream attachment metadata and stored attestation reads

lint.command: ruff check services/gateway/data_stream.py services/gateway/app.py services/gateway/router.py tests/test_gateway_data_stream.py tests/test_gateway_auth.py tests/test_gateway_route_policy_inventory.py

contracts_checked: Attachment metadata reads require the distinct data_stream_file:read:<location> grant
Attachment SQL matches both post ID and location ID and excludes deleted records
Attachment responses omit storage URLs, Directus identifiers, and arbitrary metadata
Stored attestation reads require the distinct data_stream_proof:read:<location> grant
Attestation SQL ties the request to the scoped post and returns only recorded status and proof references
Attestation read performs no live chain lookup and does not claim cryptographic verification
The database verifies each exact credential/resource/action/location in the same transaction as its query
Route policy inventory covers both endpoints and both routes remain protected from anonymous access
limitations: No candidate or legacy database was used by this focused unit and HTTP contract run
Signed attachment byte delivery and live EAS validity checks remain open
